 "data": "classDiagram
 class GameSession {
 +String code
 +ObjectId hostId
 +String hostUsername
 +String status
 +Number createdAt
 +Number lastActivityAt
 +Number currentRound
 +Number currentVoting
 +Number phaseEndAt
 +ObjectId gameId
 +Array~ObjectId~ questions
 }

 class Config {
 <<embedded>>
 +Boolean public
 +Number rounds
 +Number minPlayers
 +Number maxPlayers
 +Number answerTimeMs
 +Number votingTimeMs
 +Number revealTimeMs
 }

 class PlayerSession {
 <<embedded, Map>>
 +ObjectId id
 +String username
 +String socketId
 +Boolean connected
 +Number disconnectedAt
 +Number score
 }

 class Timers {
 <<embedded>>
 +Timer answering
 +Timer voting
 +Timer reveal
 }

 class Match {
 <<embedded, Array>>
 +Object question
 +Boolean isVoted
 }

 class MatchPlayer {
 <<embedded>>
 +ObjectId id
 +String username
 +Array~String~ answers
 +Array~ObjectId~ votedBy
 +Number score
 +Boolean isWinner
 }
